title: Foundation Vent Screen
finding: A foundation vent still fitted with its metal mesh screen. An intact screen keeps rodents and insects out while the crawlspace keeps breathing.

title: Torn Vent Screen
finding: The mesh on this foundation vent was torn open, and debris had collected behind it. A damaged screen is one of the most common entry points we find.

title: Vent Buried by Growth
finding: A foundation vent set into the block wall with grass grown right over the top of it. When vents get blocked, the crawlspace starts holding moisture.

title: Opening in the Foundation
finding: A break through the concrete block foundation wall. Openings like this let rodents and moisture straight into the crawlspace.

title: Wood-Destroying Pest Activity
finding: Signs of wood-destroying pest activity on a wooden surface inside the structure. Wood that stays in contact with soil is what invites them in.

title: Aging Crawlspace Wiring
finding: An old electrical junction in a damp crawlspace. Aging components sitting in moisture are exactly what a regular crawlspace inspection is meant to catch.
